'''{{PAGENAME}}''', also known as "'''Labrys'''", is a [[Map of Tarkov|location]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. It is the eleventh map that was added to the game. ==Description== A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park. ==Notes== This location can only be entered with a [[Labrys access keycard]] through [[Transits|transiting]] from [[Shoreline]]. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires the [[Knossos LLC facility key]].

    • ==Features== ===Insurance=== All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance [[Traders]] will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process. [[File:The Labyrinth insurance message.png]] ===Spawn chambers=== Each of the 5 spawns has its entry to the rest of the location blocked by a hazard/trap, which needs to be resolved to not die. =====Chamber 1 - Toxic pool===== [[File:The Labyrinth Chamber 1 - Toxic pool.png|thumb|right|200px|Toxic pool]] 1. Find [[Key 01]] 2. Unlock the door in the left side room 3. Press the button on the wall =====Chamber 2 - Steam hazard===== [[File:The Labyrinth Chamber 2 - Steam hazard.png|thumb|right|200px|Steam hazard]] 1. Find [[Key 02]] 2. Unlock the red door 3. Find the [[Valve handwheel]] on the 2nd floor 4. Apply the handwheel to the pipe next to the yellow door on the 1st floor =====Chamber 3 - Fire hazard===== [[File:The Labyrinth Chamber 3 - Fire hazard.png|thumb|right|200px|Fire hazard]] 1. Find [[Key 03]] 2. Unlock the far door 3. Find the [[BBQ-S43 gas torch]] 4. Apply the gas torch to the door at the start 5. Press the button at the electrical cabinet =====Chamber 4 - Shotgun trap===== [[File:The Labyrinth Chamber 4 - Shotgun trap.png|thumb|right|200px|Shotgun trap]] 1. Find [[Key 04]] 2. Unlock the 2nd door 3. Crawl into the connected room 4. Pull the lever to the left of the door 5. Breach the door =====Chamber 5 - Toxic puddle===== [[File:The Labyrinth Chamber 5 - Toxic puddle.png|thumb|right|200px|Toxic puddle]] 1. Find the [[BBQ-S43 gas torch]] 2. Apply the gas torch to the round door in the left side room 3. Pull the lever on the wall ===Traps=== =====Tripwires===== The [[tripwire]]s placed by [[Shadow of Tagilla]] on raid start have set locations. They automatically disarm after 20 minutes and don't get set off by Shadow of Tagilla. =====Poisoned barbed wire===== The barbed wire has set locations, but it is random in which it appears every raid. Upon contact, there is a chance to get inflicted with the [[File:Intoxication.png|46px|Unknown toxin]] effect, which deals gradual damage over time (140 HP/minute). It can be treated with an [[xTG-12 antidote injector|xTG-12]] or [[Perfotoran (Blue Blood) stimulant injector|Perfotoran]] injector.

After overwhelmingly positive player feedback, the devs decided to permanently keep it in the game. * [[Scavs]] in this location are better equipped than regular ones and sometimes carry [[xTG-12 antidote injector|xTG-12 injector]]s. * Scavs in this location have Greek mythology names such as Μορφέας (Morpheus) and Πύθων (Python).
